findings.title: Pages lack a descriptive main heading
findings.evidence: 1/1 sampled pages have no <h1> or only a generic one (e.g. https://example.com/).

suggested_action.summary: Give every page one descriptive H1 naming the page subject and the brand.
suggested_action.mechanism: The H1 is the first orientation cue for a reader and the title a retrieval chunk attaches to. Without it, a deep-landing visitor cannot tell where they are and an extracted chunk is untitled.
steps: Exactly one H1 per page; nest sections under H2/H3.

findings.title: No sitemap is published
findings.evidence: https://example.com/sitemap.xml returned 404 and robots.txt declares no Sitemap: directive.

suggested_action.summary: Publish sitemap.xml with accurate <lastmod> values and declare it in robots.txt.
suggested_action.mechanism: Without a sitemap, discovery relies entirely on link-following, so pages more than a couple of hops from the homepage may never be found. lastmod also supplies the freshness signal used to break ties between competing sources.
steps: Generate sitemap.xml during the build, listing every canonical URL.
Set <lastmod> from real content-change timestamps, not build time.

findings.title: Most pages have no canonical URL

suggested_action.summary: Emit a self-referential absolute canonical on every page.
suggested_action.mechanism: Without a canonical, URL variants (tracking params, www vs non-www, trailing slash) are treated as separate pages, splitting the signals that decide which one gets cited.

findings.title: Page titles and descriptions are missing or duplicated

suggested_action.summary: Give every page a unique, specific title containing the brand name, and a 1-2 sentence description stating that page's actual claim.
suggested_action.mechanism: Title and description are the highest-confidence one-line summary a machine has for what a page is about, and are what gets shown when the page is surfaced.
steps: Never reuse one title across templates.
Description states the claim, not a slogan.

findings.title: Publish a canonical, quotable facts page
findings.evidence: No defect detected for this; recommended as a proactive improvement based on how retrieval and citation work.

suggested_action.summary: Add an /about or /facts page stating the brand's atomic facts (legal name, founding year, HQ, what it sells, who it serves, pricing model, contact) in short declarative sentences.
suggested_action.mechanism: Assistants build answers from spans they can quote verbatim. A fact spread across a hero video and a PDF has no quotable span; the same fact in one clean sentence does - and gives every other site one consistent source to copy.

findings.title: Build the sameAs identity graph
findings.evidence: No defect detected for this; recommended as a proactive improvement based on how retrieval and citation work.

suggested_action.summary: Link official profiles (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, Wikidata, GitHub, app stores) from Organization.sameAs, and make each of those profiles link back.
suggested_action.mechanism: Disambiguation is a graph problem. Mutual links between independent sources are what let a system decide which similarly named entity you are.

findings.title: Seed independent corroboration off-site
findings.evidence: No defect detected for this; recommended as a proactive improvement based on how retrieval and citation work.

suggested_action.summary: Get the same phrasing of the core facts onto sources you do not control - industry directories, press, partner pages, conference bios.
suggested_action.mechanism: Single-source claims are treated as fragile. Repetition across unrelated domains is the strongest trust signal a machine has.

findings.title: Show and maintain a visible last-updated date
findings.evidence: No defect detected for this; recommended as a proactive improvement based on how retrieval and citation work.

suggested_action.summary: Display a last-updated date on pricing, docs and policy pages and mirror it in schema dateModified - and actually revise the content when you bump it.
suggested_action.mechanism: Freshness is a tiebreaker between competing sources; an undated page loses to a dated rival even when its content is newer.

findings.title: Answer real questions in the visitor's own words
findings.evidence: No defect detected for this; recommended as a proactive improvement based on how retrieval and citation work.

suggested_action.summary: Add an FAQ using real query phrasing, answer-first, marked up as FAQPage.
suggested_action.mechanism: Question-shaped headings match question-shaped queries, and an answer-first paragraph is directly liftable as a citation.
